kpvee01.title: Venus to Aries: The Date-Three Flash Mob
kpvee01.caption: Aries had the banner up by date three. Venus had notes. Grand gestures are gorgeous, just maybe after you know their middle name. Who in your group chat is already holding the banner?

kpvee02.title: Venus to Taurus: Who Feeds You?
kpvee02.caption: You remember everyone's favourite snack. Do you know yours? Say one want out loud and let someone else plan the Saturday. Receiving is a love language too. Save this for the giver in your life.

kpvee03.title: Venus to Gemini: Forty Memes, No Words
kpvee03.caption: Forty memes sent. Zero feelings stated. Venus says memes are a dialect, but the crush was waiting for three words. Tag the friend who flirts exclusively in frogs on scooters.

kpvee04.title: Venus to Cancer: The Wrong-Size Love
kpvee04.caption: Rereading the chat from someone who stopped trying hurts. Love you have to beg for is the wrong size. Archive it, call the friends who say come over, and choose you.

kpvee05.title: Venus to Leo: Compliment Them First
kpvee05.caption: Leo had a whole list of compliments ready. All about Leo. Venus flipped the card, and somehow Leo glowed brighter. Which sign would rehearse in the mirror first?

kpvee06.title: Venus to Virgo: Tear Up Page Four
kpvee06.caption: High standards are healthy. A twelve-page rubric is a lot. Keep the three that matter: kind, honest, makes you laugh. The font can be forgiven. Save this before your next first date.

kpvee07.title: Venus to Libra: Who Are You, Darling?
kpvee07.caption: Libra agreed with nine opinions in one dinner, including being a huge morning person. Venus paused the whole date. Stay for the pineapple. What's the opinion you keep quiet on dates?

kpvee08.title: Venus to Scorpio: The Spare Key Heart
kpvee08.caption: Seven locks, and nobody gets past lock one. Being open isn't weakness, it's the invitation. Start small: share one true thing, like being nervous today, and see who meets you there.

kpvee09.title: Venus to Sagittarius: They Said Coffee
kpvee09.caption: They said coffee. Sagittarius heard a 5 a.m. mountain hike. Venus suggested asking what they actually love, and the bookshop nap date won. What's your sign's version of a 14 km first date?

kpvee10.title: Venus to Capricorn: Not a Promotion
kpvee10.caption: If your plan says Q4: deserve love, this one's for you. You don't earn love by hitting a goal. Close the laptop at six, keep Friday, and let someone enjoy the version of you that's off the clock.

kpvee11.title: Venus to Aquarius: Feelings in Human
kpvee11.caption: Fixed their router, sent three articles, built them a shelf, never said a word. Venus asked for it in human. The crush already knew at the shelf. Who loves you in acts of tech support?
